verdict.unchecked_changes: The tests verify rejection of an invalid Invoke argument, but do not appear to exercise acceptance of Spec instances or the _is_spec helper’s broader type-detection behavior.
verdict.title: Validate Invoke targets
verdict.statement: `Invoke` currently accepts arbitrary objects as its target and fails later when the invocation is evaluated. Validate the target when constructing `Invoke`: accept callable objects and `Spec` instances, and otherwise raise `TypeError` with a message identifying the expected callable-or-Spec requirement. Existing `Invoke.specfunc(...)` behavior should remain supported.
